title: Patch Note - First Steps
body: The town notice board is now open. This is where future patch notes, dev notes, and questionable advice will appear.

title: Dev Note - Crafting Stations
body: Crafting from your pockets has been outlawed by common sense. Use the anvil when you want to make something real.

title: A Note from Brindle
body: If you keep bringing back goblin ears, at least start counting them properly. The quartermaster's desk has standards.
